items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: we played the Ambassador about a year and a half, the Ambassador and Ciro's in Paris... My Ciro's job was from about 9:00 to about 11:30, 12:00 o'clock

ctx.x: So he brought you to London then?
Yes. But before we went to London, we played the Ambassador about a year and a half, the Ambassador and Ciro's in Paris, you see. And Monte Carlo, 'cause you have a Ciro's in Monte Carlo.
